classNames.description:
The `mew3` class names representing the components to use in the processor.
The order of the class names in the list will be the order of the components in the processor.
The classes will be found in the `mew3.integrations` package path.

classOptions.description:
Initialization options for the `mew3` classes.
The options are specified as a map of class name to a map of option name to option value.

mew3WheelPath.description: The path to the `mew3` wheel file, which will be dynamically installed in the processor.
